# FlexiPay

> Pay anyone, anywhere. They choose how to get paid: bank account, e-wallet or crypto wallet, in USDC on Solana (devnet while in development).

This page is a clickable UX prototype with simulated data. It is not connected to the API and no money moves.
The working testnet product, tests and evidence are in the repository.

- Repository: https://github.com/Cseni1/flexipay
- Milestone status and evidence index: https://github.com/Cseni1/flexipay#hackathon-milestones
- Prior work disclosure: https://github.com/Cseni1/flexipay/blob/main/docs/PRIOR_WORK.md
